case: Linux mini and full-core interchange on QEMU i386

expected_outcomes.mini_to_full_profile: full core extracts the mini-created BoltLite/16 KiB archive byte-identically
expected_outcomes.full_to_mini_profile: mini validates and extracts the full-core-created BoltLite/16 KiB archive byte-identically
expected_outcomes.metadata: mini and full extraction preserve mode and epoch-zero file/directory times
expected_outcomes.file_directory_conflict_both_orders: mini and full refuse before changing absent or existing output roots
expected_outcomes.no_overwrite: mini refuses and retains existing bytes
expected_outcomes.corrupt_payload: mini refuses corrupted data and cleans its stage
expected_outcomes.negative_time_source: mini create refuses pre-1970 time; full reader accepts the valid resulting archive
